ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording of notable quality featuring a standout Dark Star performance
ai_review.review: The Miller‑sourced soundboard capture is praised for its clear improvement over earlier versions, delivering one of the best‑sounding Dark Star excerpts from this era. While reviewers love the jam and Jerry’s guitar work, some note thin vocal delivery and lament the band’s stylistic shift in late ’69, yielding an overall positive but slightly mixed impression.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews consistently highlight a strong Dark Star and improved sound quality; minor vocal critiques keep the rating just below top‑tier.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers mention noticeable improvement, clearer mix than previous versions, and overall better sounding recording.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Only Dark Star is singled out; reviewers focus on its jam quality rather than overall set pacing.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia's guitar work on Dark Star is highlighted as superior and a key reason for the recording’s appeal.
